answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by tying influence to a non-transferable record of verified work: a new identity starts with zero weight and must complete real, attested tasks before it can vote or trade at full capacity. A single reputation inlet checks this history, so spawning thousands of fake agents gains nothing unless each one repeats the costly work. A ferrous audit trail makes histories unforgeable and untransferable, so an attacker cannot clone one good record across sock puppets. The honest marketplace stays an oasis where weight reflects work done, not accounts created.
